title: Interspecies prediction of human drug clearance based on scaling data from one or two animal species
summary: One- and two-species CL methods were developed on 102 compounds and tested on 26 further compounds; favorable comparisons with a three-species method were reported.
validation: Empirical calibration includes human CL from other compounds; applicability to the current drug is unverified.
data_availability: Complete compound-level development and test data not inspected.
